relationships.subject: nifuroxazide
relationships.evidence_quote: Nifuroxazide reduced Th17 cell differentiation, potentially alleviating pain and depression-like behaviors.

relationships.subject: JAK/STAT3 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Our study showed that targeting JAK/STAT3 signaling alleviated pain- and depression-like behaviors in rats with BCP by inhibiting Th17 cell differentiation.

key_findings: Targeting JAK/STAT3 in the amygdala alleviates pain and depression-like behaviors in bone cancer pain rats by inhibiting Th17 differentiation.
